question: Can Rumi work in isiZulu, isiXhosa and Sesotho?
governing_thought: Yes, with three conditions. On automated tests in all three languages, Rumi plans lessons from the curriculum, transcribes classroom speech, drafts coaching and replies in voice notes. No native speaker has checked a word yet.

conditions: Transcription uses the engine that scored best for each language; each page names it.
A first-language speaker reviews every lesson, transcript and voice before a teacher sees it. Nothing on this site has had that review yet.

Coaching feedback reads as understandable, not natural (AI-judged 5.0, 2.5 and 5.0 out of 10 for isiZulu, isiXhosa, Sesotho). The voices now sound close to first-language speakers to an AI listener; a native reviewer confirms both.

legend.measured: a script compared Rumi's output with a known-good reference
legend.AI-judged: a second AI model judged it, or two engines were compared where no human reference exists; never decides a verdict
legend.native ear pending: no first-language speaker has checked it yet; true of every number on this site
legend.verdict: GREEN: every test run scored 7 or more out of 10. AMBER: one landed between 4 and 7. RED: one fell below 4. Rounding always goes against us: scores are cut down, error rates up.
